title: Session
description: One agent session: a tmux session (or an agent seen only through its hooks) and what the hub knows about it.

name.description: Unique display name, also the tmux session name when created by the hub.

tmux.description: tmux session name; absent for external sessions.

kind.description: `tmux`: a terminal the hub can show and type into. `external`: seen only through hook events. `chat`: reserved.

createdAt.description: When the session was created or first seen (Unix time, ms).

title.description: Short description, from the first prompt; may be empty.

lastTool.description: The tool the agent last used.

waitingFor.description: What the agent is asking, while `state` is `needs_input`.

transcriptPath.description: Where the agent keeps its transcript.

turnStartedAt.description: When the current turn started (Unix time, ms).

lastEventAt.description: When the last hook event arrived (Unix time, ms).

unread.description: Something happened that the owner has not looked at.

adopted.description: The tmux session was not created by the hub.

viewers.description: Open screen streams from the app.

SessionState.description: Where a session is in its lifecycle.
